description: Works through MapRoulette challenges in Maid: open a challenge by its number or pick one near you, see its tasks on the map, read the instructions next to the feature, accept a tag fix, and the tasks are reported as fixed only once your changeset is uploaded. The MapRoulette API is changing its login, so status updates wait for it.
highlights: A MapRoulette button in the top bar: the open challenge with its description, a challenge number to open, the challenges in the map view
The tasks of the view on the map, the task's ways highlighted
The task's instructions (Markdown, MapRoulette's shortcodes) and its status buttons above the feature
Tag fix challenges: the suggested tag change as a diff, accepted in one click
The save form lists the tasks it reports as fixed; MapRoulette hears of them after the upload
